svg.aria-label: About. At work, EQD Trading Analyst at Société Générale CIB: I create equity and equity-derivatives indices, run their rebalancing with S&P and Solactive, check option prices and Greeks daily, and build AI agents for the repetitive work. On my own time, LLM tools, measured: local RAG on a 4 GB laptop GPU, agents that check their own figures, evaluation with held-out sets and intervals, and a desktop and phone app for coding agents. Based in Casablanca, Morocco. Arabic, French, English. Studied at INSEA, statistics and big data.
